fc.env: In 10 other states, U.S. Senate polls by members of AAPOR's Transparency Initiative have Democrats running 3.4 points ahead of Kamala Harris's 2024 share of the two-party vote. Applied to North Carolina's 2024 presidential result (48.4% Democratic of the two-party vote) and moved a little by North Carolina's own member polls, a generic 2026 contest in North Carolina stands near 53.5% Democratic, give or take about 3.6 points.
